meta.title: CNB2API
meta.description: Keeps a cnb2api gateway running inside your own CNB workspace reachable, and turns it into a DSH model provider whose address never changes. A workspace's address changes on every restart and the platform stops idle workspaces, so the plugin follows the address in the background and restarts a stopped workspace through the CNB OpenAPI — but not while the organisation's AI credits are used up, because the gateway would answer 402 anyway. The plugin serves a fixed-base OpenAI-compatible gateway on 127.0.0.1:41729 (configurable) that hides address drift, account selection and credit failover behind it, and publishes CNB2API (route cnb-gateway) into Settings → Models — the protocol layer is DSH's own provider, so the plugin only publishes configuration. Three agent tools: cnb2api_status reports the workspace, cnb2api_start starts it, and cnb2api_quota reads the organisation's AI credits and core-hours. Everything is configured on this plugin's own page: the status panel shows each account's availability and credit (explaining that frozen credit is pre-charged, plus an alert below the credit line), and the configuration form exchanges a token for drop-down organisations and repositories. The token needs repo-cnb-trigger:rw and account-engage:r, plus group-resource:r to show quota. Serving the LAN from 0.0.0.0 requires an access key; the gateway refuses to start without one. Turning the plugin off removes the tools, routes, panel and published provider, and stops the gateway; workspaces already running are left alone.
